name: Bog Sidhe Hexer
loreTies: A fae court saboteur who protects bargains, names, and hidden roads by twisting enemy advantages into debts.
Debuffs priority abilities and shields allies with bargain wards.
source culture humans later copied as Celtic and Irish fae myth
shortBackstory: Bog Sidhe Hexer is a lore-faithful Tuatha run-in creature used when missions or events justify faction contact without rewriting the faction or creating playable squads.

chapters.title: Origin
chapters.text: Bog Sidhe Hexer belongs to Avalora and exists to express Tuatha law, pressure, or defense during Gate instability.

chapters.title: Faction Function
chapters.text: Debuffs priority abilities and shields allies with bargain wards.

chapters.title: Lore Guardrail
chapters.text: Do not use as a generic monster; keep faction law, materials, motives, and silhouette intact.

chapters.title: Campaign Use
chapters.text: It may appear in enemy-controlled zones, border conflicts, Gate events, pursuits, trials, bargains, or defensive reactions when the mission gives a lore-valid reason.

chapters.title: Visual / Encounter Rule
chapters.text: Visuals must follow: Peat-dark cloak, blue witchlight eyes, thorn crown, bone-charm staff. Abilities — Name-Tax Hex, Mire Veil, Debt Ward — must telegraph clearly for mobile one-Deity-vs-many combat.

developmentStatus: Readable faction run-in creature profile integrated into mission/event encounter pools.
